name: nextbrief
description: The portfolio context an agent should read before it starts work: what projects exist, what each one is for, what is open, and what was just closed. Wraps the read-only half of the nextbrief CLI. Every command the skill names only reads, so it is safe to run at the top of a session; taking an item off the page stays a human action. Ships the skill only: the engine is a separate zero-dependency Python package, installed with `pipx install nextbrief` or `uv tool install nextbrief`. The skill checks for it first and says so rather than failing on `command not found`.
